description: Firestore stores records as documents in collections. This course uses the local Firebase emulator to learn reads, changes, queries and rules with fake book data. The learning website itself does not connect to Firebase. Use the Firebase Emulator Suite with the demo-reading-club project and Firestore on port 8080. Install the firebase JavaScript SDK in a local browser project. Run each full snippet on a fresh page. Keep the sample rules local.
versionNote: Uses the modular Firebase Web SDK and a demo project connected only to the local Firestore emulator.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to check that the Firestore emulator is listening on port 8080
Learn to compare ids from two separate sample additions
Learn to change the document in the emulator and observe the callback
learningObjectives: Learn to check that the Firestore emulator is listening on port 8080
Learn to compare ids from two separate sample additions
Learn to change the document in the emulator and observe the callback
